findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess with shell=True
 * @description executing subprocess with shell=True can be dangerous
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-shell-true
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::ArgumentNode arg
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "run"]).getACall() and
  arg = call.getArgByName("shell") and
  arg.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
select call, "Call to subprocess with shell=True"
findings.hypothesis: Subprocess calls with shell=True might allow command injection.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Path traversal
 * @description Accessing files with user-controlled paths can lead to path traversal
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/path-traversal
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-022
 *       external/cwe/cwe-023
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module PathTraversalConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(FileSystemAccess fa).getAPathArgument()
  }
}

module PathTraversalFlow = TaintTracking::Global<PathTraversalConfig>;
import PathTraversalFlow::PathGraph

from PathTraversalFlow::PathNode source, PathTraversalFlow::PathNode sink
where PathTraversalFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Path traversal from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe file access using user-controlled paths leading to path traversal.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Logging of sensitive information
 * @description Logging sensitive information such as passwords or keys can lead to information disclosure.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/logging-sensitive-data
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-532
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node arg
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("print").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("logging").getMember(["debug", "info", "warning", "error", "critical", "log"]).getACall()
  ) and
  exists(int i | arg = call.getArg(i)) and
  exists(DataFlow::Node source, string varName |
    source = arg.getALocalSource() and
    varName = source.asExpr().(Name).getId() and
    varName.regexpMatch("(?i).*(password|secret|token|key|auth|credential).*") and
    not varName.regexpMatch("(?i).*(public|id|name).*")
  )
select call, "Potential logging of sensitive information via argument $@.", arg, arg.toString()
findings.hypothesis: Logging of sensitive information (passwords, keys, tokens) can expose them to attackers with access to logs.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Disabled SSL Certificate Verification
 * @description Disabling SSL certificate verification can allow Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacks.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/disabled-ssl-verification
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node arg
where
  (
    // aiohttp.ClientSession or request calls
    call = API::moduleImport("aiohttp").getMember("ClientSession").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("aiohttp").getMember("request").getACall() or
    // httpx (optional dependency, but used in some files)
    call = API::moduleImport("httpx").getMember(["Client", "AsyncClient", "request", "get", "post"]).getACall() or
    // requests (if used, though this is async lib)
    call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["request", "get", "post", "put", "delete", "head", "patch", "options"]).getACall()
  ) and
  (
    // Check for verify=False or ssl=False
    (
        arg = call.getArgByName("verify") and
        arg.asExpr().(ImmutableLiteral).booleanValue() = false
    ) or
    (
        arg = call.getArgByName("ssl") and
        arg.asExpr().(ImmutableLiteral).booleanValue() = false
    )
  )
select call, "SSL certificate verification is disabled."
findings.hypothesis: Disabling SSL certificate verification allows for Man-in-the-Middle attacks.
